readings: Looking at announcement timing (`eventannotm`, with a missing timing as its own group), which timings have an average institutional ownership strictly above average? Ignoring missing ownership values, give in one row the mean of those timings' average ownership and how far above average they are on average, without rounding. Define 'average' as the overall mean across all non-missing individual records.

Looking at announcement timing (`eventannotm`, with a missing timing as its own group), which timings have an average institutional ownership strictly above average? Ignoring missing ownership values, give in one row the mean of those timings' average ownership and how far above average they are on average, without rounding. Define 'average' as the mean of the per-timing averages, so each timing counts equally.

queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_all
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
grp AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_own
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_own) AS mean_of_timing_averages,
       AVG(g.avg_own - o.avg_all) AS mean_excess_over_average
FROM grp g, overall o
WHERE g.avg_own > o.avg_all;
WITH per AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
  HAVING COUNT(instownpct) > 0
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM per
)
SELECT AVG(per.a) AS mean_avg_ownership, AVG(per.a - overall.m) AS mean_excess
FROM per, overall
WHERE per.a > overall.m;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
), o AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS m
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
)
SELECT AVG(g.a) AS mean_avg_ownership, AVG(g.a - o.m) AS mean_diff_above_average
FROM g, o
WHERE g.a > o.m;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS oa
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
)
SELECT AVG(g.a) AS mean_avg_ownership,
       AVG((g.a - o.oa) * 100.0 / o.oa) AS avg_pct_above
FROM g, o
WHERE g.a > o.oa;
